description: An optional variant within a product family (e.g. VM Plans -> CPU Optimised; Remote Storage -> Backups). Used only where a real variant axis exists; families like AI Tokens have none (ADR 0007). For VM compute profiles it also carries the memory ratio the configurator pins.

fields.label: Composed-Config Bounds
fields.description: VM compute profiles only (ADR 0009): the runtime constraints a design-your-own config is validated against. Blank for non-compute families.

fields.label: RAM Ratio
fields.description: GB RAM per vCPU for this optimisation profile (RAM = vCPU x ratio). Source of truth for the configurator's pinned ratio.

fields.label: vCPU Steps
fields.description: Comma-separated allowed vCPU values, e.g. 1,2,4,8,16. The slider snaps to these.

fields.label: Memory Ratio (legacy)
fields.description: Legacy display of ram_ratio as a 1:N string; ram_ratio is authoritative. Kept for backward-compatibility.

name: Plan Sub-Category
